items.title: Micro Action
items.copy: lawyer I coach showed up slammed, no bandwidth, threw out the plan, micro actions one step, momentum beats magnitude, staircase one stair at a time, busy professionals, business development

items.title: Could You Do This?
items.copy: lawyer tells me they cannot do business development, could you do this, walking down the ladder rung by rung, big asks freeze people, comfort comes from the doing, absurdly small

items.title: Tied Up in Knots
items.copy: 30 years of coaching lawyers, tied up in nots, every suggestion gets a no, not me not my clients, self-perception, I'm just not a business developer, watching a person change what they believe they are capable of

items.title: 4 reasons cross-selling stalls (Draft #476)
items.copy: growing existing clients slide, cross-serving, stalls for 4 reasons, lack of planning client names who introduces whom, lack of skills describe a colleague's practice, lack of structure comp system doesn't pay a partner to hand over a relationship nobody owns the account, lack of follow-through, law firm leadership partner compensation

items.title: Everything was used to (Draft #490)
items.copy: sole equity owner mid-sized firm seven states, used to issue newsletters attend industry events, nobody voted to end any of it, the fortune is in the follow up, I tell them to do things they don't do it, they need structure a cadence a scoreboard, inspiration fades by Friday structure survives the busy season

items.title: The book has not moved in three years (Draft #473)
items.copy: practice group talented lawyers book has not moved in three years, they're buried, idling engine, not more training, reminders create clarity being watched creates motivation, who is asking your group on Friday, law firm management business development

items.title: The Budget Season Question
items.copy: law firm budget season buy the same thing they bought last year, what did last year's spend actually change, what behaviors moved, firms buy learning the learning dies on the vine, biggest gap is not planning it is doing, fund the follow-through reminders accountability

items.title: The Exoskeleton
items.copy: we gave them the training if they don't use it that's on them, deliverers finders and minders of the work, billable hour keeps score, exoskeletal structures reminders repetition carrots, training builds the muscle exoskeleton makes it move, expecting willpower to do a system's job

items.title: The Question Nobody Is Asking
items.copy: every conversation about AI in the legal industry, which parts of a lawyer's job will disappear, if that part of the job is gone then what is your job, job becomes winning the work not just doing the work, relationships trust top of mind, AI adoption committees, turn more lawyers into rainmakers, when the doing gets cheaper the getting becomes everything

items.title: The Other 25 Hours
items.copy: a matter that used to take 40 hours may soon take 15, clients can do that math, not going to keep paying for hours AI handed back, engine that built legal careers billing hours losing horsepower, efficiency compresses every matter, origination stops being a specialty it becomes a survival skill, AI rainmakers

items.title: Bureauplasticity Is Back
items.copy: coined a word bureauplasticity, neuroplasticity brain rewires, rigid law firm bureaucracy flexes when environment shifts, AmLaw 200 managing partner institutional inertia, COVID firms did in weeks what took a decade, AI has the steel rod glowing red hot, law firm leadership change management

items.title: Just do good work is old advice (Draft #475)
items.copy: one piece of BD advice needs to be vanquished just do good work and that is enough, hairdresser clippers you go back to the one who remembers, AI will do more of that work faster cheaper at three in the morning, which leaves the relationships, seniority buys you none of that skill, rainmaking legal AI client relationships

items.title: You No Longer Have to Be the Most Brilliant Lawyer
items.copy: told to be the smartest most technically excellent lawyer, AI has made brilliance table stakes, research draft analyze, you need to be known trusted the name that surfaces at 11pm own the mental real estate, coaching more than 10,000 lawyers, technical skill opens the door relationships build the book, rainmakers business development AI

items.title: Noticed in a World of Noise
items.copy: everyone talking about what AI means for legal work faster research fewer hours per matter, almost nobody talking about what it means for lawyer business development, what will your personal value be, trusted relationships meeting more people a brand that gets you noticed, rainmakers of the next decade noticed in a world of noise
